sections.title: The letter effe
paragraphs: The letter is named (effe) /ˈɛffe/. Its sound is heard in (fare) /ˈfa.re/, which means to do, to make. This letter has only one sound. A consonant is a sound made when the mouth blocks or narrows the air. It makes a steady voiceless consonant.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Place your upper teeth gently on your lower lip. Blow air smoothly through the narrow gap. Keep your vocal cords still. Put a hand on your throat. You feel no shake at all.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter always has the same sound in all positions. You hear it at the start of (fare) /ˈfa.re/. You also hear it in (caffè) /kafˈfɛ/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes
paragraphs: This sound is just like the sound in the English word fish. You do not make any real mistake with this letter. Just keep the air flowing steadily between your teeth and lip.
